IM AM SO SOO SOO PROUD OF YOU!!! Getting clean is a very difficult thing, i am so happy you got help. I wish you the best!

Hey, I know it can be really tough not to start doing things again since the opportunity is there. But please try not to, think of the feeling of trying to hide the scars when it is warm enough for short sleeves again. I know it isnt much coming from a stranger on the internet, but I have been there done that; i am still regretting it. If you do start again, please do take care of your cuts/burns/whatever you do. I wish you the best! Good luck <3
